changes.old: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your melee abilities by $m1%.
changes.new: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your melee abilities by $m1% and increases your spell healing by $s2% of your Intellect.

changes.old: Gives you a $m1% chance to gain $/10;17057s1 Rage when you shapeshift into Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. When you shift into Cat Form, you will regain ${100*($m2/100)}% of the Energy you had when you were last in Cat Form, plus ${10*($m2/100)} Energy for each second you spent not in Bear Form, Cat Form, or Dire Bear Form, up to a maximum of ${100*($m2/100)} Energy.
changes.new:
Gives you a $m1% chance to gain $/10;17057s1 Rage when shapeshifting into Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. Shapeshifting into Cat Form restores ${100*($m2/100)}% of the Energy you had when last in Cat Form, plus ${10*($m2/100)} Energy per sec spent outside Cat Form, up to ${100*($m2/100)} Energy.

Bear Form and Dire Bear Form forfeit this Energy and halt its restoration while active.
